Update Dec 2024.
After being a customer for more than 2 years now, have to unfortunately write this negative feedback. A complete sham and nothing less than fraud. Had given the vehicle to service and few repairs in month of August. However on receipt lots of issues  cropped up. Auto lock, stereo system, door light Indicator not operational. Managed to sort minor issues raised but still auto lock not working. Upon delivery of vehicle, tge tire was found punctured.
Had changed with new battery with them an year ago. There were some issues with battery a few months ago. Suggested him that the battery is still under warranty and if required we should replace. He kept on assuring that the battery is good and no need for change. However once the warranty was expired he advised to change the battery.
Now the most Important part, had replaced all 4 wheels (Appollo) with new ones (Bridgestone) in December 2022 with Auto Doc and had been doing the services from them only. However a few days ago observed that the rear wheels were replaced with old ones. Came to know  when i saw that the aft one were Appollo wheels. As usual the owner was not available for any explanation and the mechanic says someone must have replaced them when vehicle was parked. Such a hilarious excuse as if the thieves are kind enough to replace the stolen wheels. Attached pics for reference.
Strictly no go in future.

featured_reviews.name: Vivek Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst Service Ever – Completely Irresponsible and Untrustworthy

Patel Auto Service is the worst garage I have ever dealt with. I gave my car to them for starter and alternator repairs, and they claimed all components were replaced. Shockingly, both failed again within just 2–3 days, which clearly proves their incompetence and fake workmanship.

When I reported the issue, they kept my car for two more days and during that time they damaged the underside of my car while lifting it. They hid this damage and did not inform me at all. I noticed it myself later. When confronted, instead of properly repairing it, they did a cheap cover-up job, just trying to hide the dents rather than fixing the damage.

This garage shows zero professionalism, zero accountability, and zero respect for customers’ cars. They will damage your vehicle, lie about it, and then do patch-up work to escape responsibility.

Extremely pathetic service. Totally unreliable people.
Never ever give your car to Patel Auto Service if you value your money or love your car.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Mr. Vivek Yadav,

We are genuinely sorry to read about your experience and regret the inconvenience you have felt. Customer trust is extremely important to us, and we take such feedback seriously.

To clarify the matter for transparency: your vehicle was attended for a starter-related issue, after which we remained in communication with you. The vehicle was also used outside Mumbai during this period without any immediate concern being reported to us.

Regarding the underbody concern, the vehicle is considerably aged and showed signs of corrosion. While such issues can sometimes surface during repair work, our standard practice is always to inform customers if any damage is noticed. In this case, despite there being no intentional negligence, we still took responsibility in good faith and carried out denting and painting work at no cost, which was personally inspected and accepted at the time of delivery.

We strongly refute any suggestion of dishonesty or intentional cover-up. Our team strives to act transparently and professionally at all times.

That said, we respect your feedback and regret that we could not meet your expectations. We remain open to discussing this matter further and resolving any remaining concerns directly.

What truly stands out is his honesty, clear recommendations, and reasonable charges. He also shared all possible options, including upgrading to an Android system, without any pressure.

Very satisfied with the service and highly recommend Mr. Zameer bhai of Ummishah Electronics Malad West for reliable and trustworthy car audio system work.
